title: Living in a World Without Magic Anime Film Project Expands Overseas With Fan Campaign, Annecy Panel, and Anime Expo 2026 Appearance
content: The feature film adaptation project for Living in a World Without Magic continues to move forward, with new international initiatives announced as the production seeks to expand its global reach and connect directly with anime fans worldwide.
author: Anime Corner

title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Blu-ray Reveals New Tanjiro, Giyu, Shinobu, and Zenitsu Store Bonus Illustrations
content: New retailer-exclusive illustrations for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba – Infinity Castle Arc Chapter 1: Akaza Returns have been revealed ahead of the film’s Blu-ray and DVD release on July 29. The new artwork will be used for store-specific purchase bonuses and merchandise related to the upcoming home video release.
author: Anime Corner

title: Coco and Rozemyne Meet in Witch Hat Atelier x Ascendance of a Bookworm Collaboration Visual
content: The anime adaptations of Witch Hat Atelier and Ascendance of a Bookworm: Adopted Daughter of an Archduke have revealed a special collaboration visual featuring the protagonists of both fantasy series.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru Anime Unveils October Premiere
content: Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru’ s ( I’m Dating a Dark Summoner ) production team has released a new visual for the upcoming anime adaptation of Shaoh’s erotic fantasy rom-com manga. Alongside the visual release, they announced that the anime will premiere in October.
author: Anime Corner

title: 7 Years Later, Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Returns With a New Release
content: 2025 was a chaotic year for Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump , with several manga cancellations, as some of them got discontinued before even releasing their first volumes. Ever since it was launched in 1968, Weekly Shonen Jump has serialized several iconic series, including Dragon Ball, One Piece, Naruto, Bleach , and…

title: 33 Years Later, Classic Historical Action Anime Gets a New Release
content: The 1990s decade was a golden era in the world of anime that connected Japanese pop culture to the international audience, which helped pave the way for the medium’s phenomenal success that we witness now.
author: ComicBook

title: Monster Creator Returns With an Exciting New Release This Year
content: Naoki Urasawa is one of the most legendary manga creators of all time, and his works are always praised among readers for their exceptional art style and storytelling. While the creator is best known for Monster, a 1994 manga, he has also worked on more than a dozen titles.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Summer Anime Reveals New Look After Early Release
content: The Spring 2026 anime season is almost over, and the new Summer lineup looks as exciting as ever. 2026 has been one of the best years for anime fans in recent years, with the return of beloved shows such as Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 2, Jujutsu Kaisen Season 3, and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland Anime Nominated for N. American TV Critics' Awards
content: Two live-action series based on Japanese stories, Drops of God and Last Samurai Standing , also received nominations for Outstanding International Series, a new category this year. The other nominees are The Boyfriend, Crime Scene Zero, The House of the Spirits, and Squid Game .
author: ANN

title: The End of This 400+ Episode Anime Will Bring Us Closer to Solving One of Shonen’s Biggest Debates
content: An anime classic is ending this summer after more than 400 episodes, and it will bring viewers closer to solving one of shonen’s greatest debates — though it’ll be a while before it’s fully settled. Not many anime are lucky enough to get 100+ episode runs , but the ones that do become staples of the medium.
author: ComicBook
